reviews.text:
Unfortunately, I don’t own a pool in Lantana, TX — because if I did, I would be a lifelong customer of Clearly Perfect Pool Service.

My dog, Bruno, was staying at my girlfriend’s house and managed to get out. Thankfully, Brett, a technician with Clearly Perfect Pool Service, found him. Bruno had my phone number on his tag, and Brett took the time to call me and personally return him.

He was incredibly friendly and truly went above and beyond to help reunite us with our dog. That kind of character and customer care says everything about the people Clearly Perfect Pool Service hires.

Huge thanks to Brett and the Clearly Perfect Pool Service team!
reviews.author: Steve Kneller

data.summary: The contractor has a long, established history with strong accreditation (BBB A+). The primary concern is the extremely low review count on Google (2) which seems inconsistent with a 36-year-old business, though one review is highly detailed and authentic. The substantial Yelp presence (46 reviews, 4.5 stars) lends credibility. There is no evidence of review manipulation, but the data is sparse on some platforms.
fake_signals: Very low review volume on Google (2 reviews) for a 36-year-old business
One Google review is about a dog rescue, not pool service
authentic_signals: BBB A+ rating and accreditation since 2006
Yelp shows substantial review count (46) with a realistic 4.5 rating
One Google review contains specific names (Brett, Kraig) and details of service expertise
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistently high across Google (5.0), Yelp (4.5), and BBB (A+). The lack of negative reviews on Google is notable but not inherently suspicious given the small sample size and the company's long-standing reputation.
